title: Cyclists killed or seriously injured
description: 214 cyclists were killed or seriously injured ("incapacitating" in police records) in the 12 months through 2026-07-10, vs 167 the prior 12 months. Vision Zero's goal is zero.
caveat: Counts, not rates — ridership growth is not netted out. Recent months are provisional.

title: How much of the network protects riders
description: Only 15% of Chicago's 446 on-street bikeway miles are physically protected lanes (69 mi); counting buffered lanes brings it to 39%. The rest is paint, sharrows, and greenways. Off-street trails are tracked separately.
caveat: Share of current on-street network mileage as of 2026-07-12; protected = barrier/curb-protected on-street lanes. Off-street trails are excluded — they live in the separate OSM layer.

title: Highest crash-density corridors
description: Top corridors by cyclist crashes per km of bikeway: Kinzie (77.46/km); Wells (50.82/km); Clark (45.66/km); Milwaukee (42.73/km); Dearborn (37.44/km).
caveat: Raw counts, not normalized by bike volume. Dooring is undercounted. Per-km rates inflate short segments — Kinzie's rate rides on very few km.

title: How often the driver leaves
description: In 27% of police-reported cyclist crashes since Sept 2017 (4637 of 17235), the driver left the scene — 27% when the cyclist was injured.
caveat: Share of reported crashes; unreported crashes are not counted.

title: Ward concentration
description: 5 of 50 wards account for 27% of located cyclist crashes since Sept 2017: Ward 27 (1186), Ward 42 (1092), Ward 32 (820), Ward 1 (817), Ward 34 (656).
caveat: Ward totals reflect where people ride most, not only where streets are worst.

title: Dooring: structurally undercounted
description: 2031 crashes since Sept 2017 carry a dooring flag. Dooring is structurally excluded from 'reportable' crash records unless damage/injury thresholds are met, so the real number is higher than any count on this site.
caveat: A floor, not a full count.
